name: Born to Breed
source:
A futanari visual novel where you can breed centaurs, goblins, and much more. 

Severely lacking in common sense, Sophie is a curious and horny human girl with a little extra between her legs. After waking in an unknown location, Sophie quickly came to realize what her unique body was yearning for.

[Edited from [url=https://rfh-games.itch.io/born-to-breed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部扶他视觉小说，你可以在其中培育半人马、妖精等等。

苏菲严重缺乏常识，是一个充满好奇心、好色的人类女孩，两腿之间有一点多余的东西。在一个未知的地点醒来后，苏菲很快意识到自己独特的身体所向往的是什么。

[编辑自[url=https://rfh-games.itch.io/born-to-breed]itch.io[/url]]
